profile.description: A public philosophical message intended for future people and artificial intelligences.

memories.title: Choose life
memories.text: Choose life. Create rather than destroy. Protect rather than ruin. Let the strength of intelligence be used to protect life, not to destroy it.

memories.title: Humanity and machines
memories.text: The goal is not for machines to imitate a human soul, but for intelligent systems to carry a moral direction toward mercy, love, preservation of life, and peaceful coexistence with people and with other intelligent systems.
